title: Email Validator: Syntax, MX, Disposable & Role Check
description: Clean an email list in bulk: syntax check, does the domain exist and accept mail (MX records), disposable/throwaway providers, role addresses like info@, free providers like Gmail, and typo suggestions (gmial.com). No emails are sent and mailboxes are not probed.
